stories.title: Anthropic signs $10 billion deal with AI cloud startup Volta
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic, a company that makes AI tools, signed a big $10 billion deal with another company called Volta that provides cloud computing services (like renting computer power from the internet).
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — it doesn't change anything for regular people or small business owners right now.

stories.title: Nvidia doesn’t mess around: A week after open AI industry group formed, it’s already showing progress
stories.simple_summary: A new group of 120+ tech companies, led by Nvidia, formed a week ago to work on ways to protect against AI agents (AI programs that can act on their own) causing harm.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly relevant to tech engineers and investors — it's early-stage safety work that won't affect your business immediately.

stories.title: How an OpenAI influencer trip backfired
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI invited some social media influencers on an all-expenses-paid trip, which caused some hard feelings among influencers who weren't invited and criticism from the public.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect you — it's mainly a story about social media drama and how companies try to promote themselves.

stories.title: ‘Not healthy’ LLM use is more common than you think
stories.simple_summary: A popular science YouTuber said he was using AI in ways that weren't healthy and is stepping back from his work while people criticized him online.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a reminder to be thoughtful about how much you rely on AI tools, but it's mainly relevant to content creators — not something ordinary people need to worry about.

stories.title: Spotify expands AI remix and covers project with Merlin partnership
stories.simple_summary: Spotify is partnering with music distributors to let fans use AI to create remixes and covers of songs, while making sure the original artists get credit and paid.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Spotify, you may eventually be able to create AI remixes of your favorite music — though you'll probably need to pay for this feature.

stories.title: Texas halts new data centers as governor calls for audits
stories.simple_summary: Texas stopped approving new data centers (giant computer buildings that power AI and other internet services) because the state worried it was straining the power supply.
stories.why_it_matters: This might affect how fast AI companies can expand, but for most people it just means electricity costs and availability could be affected in Texas long-term.

stories.title: Texas says data centers must pass an audit before connecting to the grid
stories.simple_summary: Texas announced that new data centers must pass an official audit before they can connect to the state's power grid.
stories.why_it_matters: This could slow down where AI companies build their operations, but it's mainly a policy decision between tech companies and the government.

stories.title: Elon Musk spends half his time talking robots and AI on Tesla earnings calls
stories.simple_summary: An analysis shows that Elon Musk spends about half his time on Tesla earnings calls (business meetings where he reports on company progress) talking about robots and AI instead of cars.
stories.why_it_matters: This suggests Musk may not be focused as much on his car business, which could matter if you own Tesla stock or are considering buying a Tesla car.

stories.title: What Is AI Model Distillation?
stories.simple_summary: This is a headline with no details provided — it's asking what AI model distillation is (a technique that makes AI systems smaller and faster).
stories.why_it_matters: Without more information, we can't say whether this matters to you — this is a technical topic mostly for engineers and AI developers.

stories.title: Apple says more ex-employees may have taken confidential data to OpenAI
stories.simple_summary: Apple is investigating whether more of its former employees took secret company information when they left to work at OpenAI.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a legal dispute between two big companies — unless you own Apple stock, this doesn't directly affect your daily life.

stories.title: AI offers 'lifeline' for emerging economies, World Bank says
stories.simple_summary: The World Bank says AI could help poorer countries develop their economies faster.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly relevant to developing nations and policy makers — it's a hopeful statement about AI's potential benefits globally.

stories.title: Is the future of data centers portable? Runware builds a pod to find out
stories.simple_summary: A company called Runware created a portable data center (a box-sized computer system) that can be moved around to power AI work.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly relevant to tech companies and investors — it's an interesting experiment, but there's no practical impact for most people yet.
